answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a vertex bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the zephyr schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
